xiao.usb_reserve_status: design reserve, informed by native silk and official footprint; not actual plug dimensions
xiao.native_vs_official_outline_note: Legacy EDA module outline is offset about0.22mm from current official V1.3 PCB outline after pin registration. Native pads remain authoritative for carrier mating; use registered official outline plus fit clearance for enclosure.

c1001.thickness_status: vendor CAD nominal only, not measured hardware
c1001.module_frame: origin=lower-left board corner, +X right, +Y toward VIN end, +Z toward components/antenna face
c1001.step_warning: STEP assembly includes Free-Models geometry transformed outside the22x22 board footprint; raw CARTESIAN_POINT bounds also mix nested frames. Do not use whole-file point extrema as actual module dimensions. Board solid and hole surfaces are independently identifiable.

service.JP1: 5V_ISO to5V_MCU isolation; remove before USB programming
service.JP2: MCU transmit series link to RADAR_RX; remove before USB programming
service.JP3: MCU receive series link to RADAR_TX; remove before USB programming
service.programming_procedure: Disconnect external5V; remove JP1,JP2,JP3; then connect XIAO USB. Preserve top-face access for shunt removal and USB plug insertion.
service.connector_direction_note: J1-J5 and JP1-JP3 row direction is exact; chosen plastic housing, polarisation, wire bend radius and insertion height are not fixed by PCB artwork.
service.external_usb_input: Panel USB-C5V daughterboard connects to J1; it is not XIAO programming USB and not a carrier-board component.

limitations: Layer48 is EDA footprint outline/assembly artwork; neither its line width nor its bbox is a measured package body or a tolerance-qualified courtyard.

Pad+layer48 unions are source-derived planar references. Tiny native pad offsets (under0.0002mm) are immaterial at enclosure scale and omitted from pad bounds; component height and cable fit remain separate constraints.
No live PCB changes, connector substitutions or Gerber modifications were made.
